items.title: Louis Tio Interview, 1960-10-26
items.q: Ricard Alexis was one that told us that, I believe your uncle, Louis Thiel, was over in Bay St. Louis for a while.

ctx.x: So I had to get someone to arrange this orchestration. And that's where my uncle and my father did well.

Well, uh, before I forget it, um, some people, um, Ricard Alexis was one that told us that, I believe your uncle, Louis Thiel, was over in Bay St. Louis for a while. Do you remember? Yes, we lived there a while.
